answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 16146 Country: United Kingdom Title: Asalamualakum I have a question regarding wearing new clothes/stuff on Friday. I heard one of my friend saying that if you wear the new clothes on Friday you will not be asked about it on the day of judgment. I would like to know to what extent this is correct? Question: Asalamualakum I have a question regarding wearing new clothes/stuff on Friday. I heard one of my friend saying that if you wear the new clothes on Friday you will not be asked about it on the day of judgment. I would like to know to what extent this is correct? Answer ID: 16146 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1754/D=254/K=1430) It is mustahab to wear best of available clothes on Friday, even if it is not new then also it is alright. As far as questioning in qiyamah is concerned, we did not see any such hadith. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
